meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Primordial Reconstruction
meta.description: What sort of world will you create once you make up your mind to stop hesitating?

units.rawText: Experimental apparatus, space suits...
units.displayText: Experimental apparatus, space suits...

spans.text: Experimental apparatus, space suits...

units.rawText: The space suit she's holding is the one that Fresnel gave her back then. Thanks to it, she didn't get knocked unconscious by being bounced around the insides of the ship.
units.displayText: The space suit she's holding is the one that Fresnel gave her back then. Thanks to it, she didn't get knocked unconscious by being bounced around the insides of the ship.

spans.text: The space suit she's holding is the one that Fresnel gave her back then. Thanks to it, she didn't get knocked unconscious by being bounced around the insides of the ship.

units.rawText: Croque's modified welder...
units.displayText: Croque's modified welder...

spans.text: Croque's modified welder...

units.rawText: Hubble remembers how she and Fresnel laughed in private about how Croque made it look like a pineapple.
units.displayText: Hubble remembers how she and Fresnel laughed in private about how Croque made it look like a pineapple.

spans.text: Hubble remembers how she and Fresnel laughed in private about how Croque made it look like a pineapple.

units.rawText: Emergency rations...
units.displayText: Emergency rations...

spans.text: Emergency rations...

units.rawText: She remembers how Choco pushed the chocolates there onto her and kept reminding her about the importance of replenishing her energy in space.
units.displayText: She remembers how Choco pushed the chocolates there onto her and kept reminding her about the importance of replenishing her energy in space.

spans.text: She remembers how Choco pushed the chocolates there onto her and kept reminding her about the importance of replenishing her energy in space.

units.rawText: One precious item after another goes out the hatch, carrying happy memories of the past with them as they fall, shatter and are subsumed into the entropized ground. Meanwhile...
units.displayText: One precious item after another goes out the hatch, carrying happy memories of the past with them as they fall, shatter and are subsumed into the entropized ground. Meanwhile...

spans.text: One precious item after another goes out the hatch, carrying happy memories of the past with them as they fall, shatter and are subsumed into the entropized ground. Meanwhile...

units.rawText: Sector mass elimination progress updated.
units.displayText: Sector mass elimination progress updated.

spans.text: Sector mass elimination progress updated.

units.rawText: Just a little more and we'll have compensated for the hard drives' mass!
units.displayText: Just a little more and we'll have compensated for the hard drives' mass!

spans.text: Just a little more and we'll have compensated for the hard drives' mass!

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: The self-defense firearms are gone, the backup gear is gone, by this time, the ship's hold is pretty much gone.
units.displayText: The self-defense firearms are gone, the backup gear is gone, by this time, the ship's hold is pretty much gone.

spans.text: The self-defense firearms are gone, the backup gear is gone, by this time, the ship's hold is pretty much gone.

units.rawText: However, the entropization shows no signs of stopping, even though the heat death progress bar is still going.
units.displayText: However, the entropization shows no signs of stopping, even though the heat death progress bar is still going.

spans.text: However, the entropization shows no signs of stopping, even though the heat death progress bar is still going.

units.rawText: We should have dumped enough stuff to make up for the hard drives... So why hasn't the sector reset yet?
units.displayText: We should have dumped enough stuff to make up for the hard drives... So why hasn't the sector reset yet?

spans.text: We should have dumped enough stuff to make up for the hard drives... So why hasn't the sector reset yet?

units.rawText: The progress bar says there's just a little more... We've already detached the boosters, so the only thing we can ditch now are the escape pods, but...
units.displayText: The progress bar says there's just a little more... We've already detached the boosters, so the only thing we can ditch now are the escape pods, but...

spans.text: The progress bar says there's just a little more... We've already detached the boosters, so the only thing we can ditch now are the escape pods, but...

units.rawText: The escape pod alone won't be enough to make up for that last shortfall...
units.displayText: The escape pod alone won't be enough to make up for that last shortfall...

spans.text: The escape pod alone won't be enough to make up for that last shortfall...

units.rawText: Warning, contact with the Gabon Joint Research Base Data Center has been lost due to entropization.
units.displayText: Warning, contact with the Gabon Joint Research Base Data Center has been lost due to entropization.

spans.text: Warning, contact with the Gabon Joint Research Base Data Center has been lost due to entropization.

units.rawText: Hubble looks up at the sky, which has been dyed a creepy purple by entropization, and then she looks at the hard drives behind her.
units.displayText: Hubble looks up at the sky, which has been dyed a creepy purple by entropization, and then she looks at the hard drives behind her.

spans.text: Hubble looks up at the sky, which has been dyed a creepy purple by entropization, and then she looks at the hard drives behind her.

units.rawText: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied it over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.
units.displayText: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied it over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.

spans.text: As the administrator of Jiutian sector, I have accompanied it over the course of its life. From the moment I was awakened, the importance of my task and its value has been constantly drilled into me.

units.rawText: The importance of Jiutian has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...
units.displayText: The importance of Jiutian has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...

spans.text: The importance of Jiutian has been written into my base layer logic. It has always been a source of pride for me...

units.rawText: But now... During this time of crisis, I realize that what I truly took pride in was the fact that I built this sector with you.
units.displayText: But now... During this time of crisis, I realize that what I truly took pride in was the fact that I built this sector with you.

spans.text: But now... During this time of crisis, I realize that what I truly took pride in was the fact that I built this sector with you.

units.rawText: As long as the stars shine upon us, we shall be reunited in Jiutian...
units.displayText: As long as the stars shine upon us, we shall be reunited in Jiutian...

spans.text: As long as the stars shine upon us, we shall be reunited in Jiutian...

units.rawText: Jiutian's technology and resources far exceed those of the Oasis. Hopefully we can use this chance to forge an alliance with them.
units.displayText: Jiutian's technology and resources far exceed those of the Oasis. Hopefully we can use this chance to forge an alliance with them.

spans.text: Jiutian's technology and resources far exceed those of the Oasis. Hopefully we can use this chance to forge an alliance with them.

units.rawText: That said, the most important thing is still having everyone come back safely.
units.displayText: That said, the most important thing is still having everyone come back safely.

spans.text: That said, the most important thing is still having everyone come back safely.

units.rawText: Fresnel... Thank you for coming here with me.
units.displayText: Fresnel... Thank you for coming here with me.

spans.text: Fresnel... Thank you for coming here with me.

units.rawText: Well, of course I had to go. What would happen if you lost yourself in Jiutian and never came back?
units.displayText: Well, of course I had to go. What would happen if you lost yourself in Jiutian and never came back?

spans.text: Well, of course I had to go. What would happen if you lost yourself in Jiutian and never came back?

units.rawText: Hehe... How could that be? The stars belong in the heavens, but I belong in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Hehe... How could that be? The stars belong in the heavens, but I belong in the Oasis.

spans.text: Hehe... How could that be? The stars belong in the heavens, but I belong in the Oasis.

units.rawText: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...
units.displayText: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...

spans.text: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...

units.rawText: Make sure you help me save the Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!
units.displayText: Make sure you help me save the Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!

spans.text: Make sure you help me save the Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!

units.rawText: Yes, we will!
units.displayText: Yes, we will!

spans.text: Yes, we will!

units.rawText: Hubble stands at the entrance to the ship's hold. There is no fear on her face, only gratitude and appreciation.
units.displayText: Hubble stands at the entrance to the ship's hold. There is no fear on her face, only gratitude and appreciation.

spans.text: Hubble stands at the entrance to the ship's hold. There is no fear on her face, only gratitude and appreciation.

units.rawText: Hubble, I'm going to dump the escape pod. We'll be accelerating soon, so close the hatch.
units.displayText: Hubble, I'm going to dump the escape pod. We'll be accelerating soon, so close the hatch.

spans.text: Hubble, I'm going to dump the escape pod. We'll be accelerating soon, so close the hatch.

units.rawText: ...Hubble?
units.displayText: ...Hubble?

spans.text: ...Hubble?

units.rawText: Fresnel turns, but finds the hold empty.
units.displayText: Fresnel turns, but finds the hold empty.

spans.text: Fresnel turns, but finds the hold empty.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, a new terminal has appeared beside the sector data hard drives at some point. Fresnel remembers that this terminal contains the backups of Belka, Xinghuan, Yuwang, and the backups for all the agents in the Jiutian sector.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, a new terminal has appeared beside the sector data hard drives at some point. Fresnel remembers that this terminal contains the backups of Belka, Xinghuan, Yuwang, and the backups for all the agents in the Jiutian sector.

spans.text: Meanwhile, a new terminal has appeared beside the sector data hard drives at some point. Fresnel remembers that this terminal contains the backups of Belka, Xinghuan, Yuwang, and the backups for all the agents in the Jiutian sector.

units.rawText: Click—
units.displayText: Click—

spans.text: Click—

units.rawText: The escape pod was activated?! No, stop...
units.displayText: The escape pod was activated?! No, stop...

spans.text: The escape pod was activated?! No, stop...

units.rawText: Fresnel frantically looks at the words on the terminal.
units.displayText: Fresnel frantically looks at the words on the terminal.

spans.text: Fresnel frantically looks at the words on the terminal.

units.rawText: Why don't I have permission to edit this...
units.displayText: Why don't I have permission to edit this...

spans.text: Why don't I have permission to edit this...

units.rawText: Could it be...
units.displayText: Could it be...

spans.text: Could it be...

units.rawText: <size=100>Hubble?! HUBBLE!!!!!!!</size>
units.displayText: Hubble?! HUBBLE!!!!!!!

spans.text: Hubble?! HUBBLE!!!!!!!

units.rawText: Her mournful wail echoes through the air. Hubble smiles at Fresnel from where she's plummeting to earth, but they are too far apart now.
units.displayText: Her mournful wail echoes through the air. Hubble smiles at Fresnel from where she's plummeting to earth, but they are too far apart now.

spans.text: Her mournful wail echoes through the air. Hubble smiles at Fresnel from where she's plummeting to earth, but they are too far apart now.

units.rawText: Fresnel cannot see her.
units.displayText: Fresnel cannot see her.

spans.text: Fresnel cannot see her.
